title: Verify and check UI changes of loader master page.
preconditions:
1.User should be on the home page
2.Data Source already configured.
3.Data Stream already configured.

steps.action: Go to Extraction & Load Layer -> Loader Configuration
steps.expectedResult: User should be redirect to the list page of loader configuration
Loader configuration master page should be open

steps.action: Observe the changes on the loader master page
steps.expectedResult:
1.DB Related fields should be removed.
2.Table name field should be removed.
3. test connection button should be removed.
4.Date format field should be non editable.
